{{recipe}}

[http://www.foodista.com/blog/2012/06/01/sushi-lovers-seaweed-salad Originally posted to Foodista] by user Leah Rodrigues. Foodista recipes are released under a [http://www.foodista.com/static/legal CC-BY license].

==Ingredients==
*1 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounce]] assorted dried [[Cookbook:Seaweed|seaweed]] or [[Cookbook:Wakame|wakame]]
*¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]] [[Cookbook:Shallot|shallot]], [[Cookbook:Green Onion|scallion]] or [[Cookbook:Red onion|red onion]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Soy Sauce|soy sauce]]
*1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Rice Vinegar|rice vinegar]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Mirin|mirin]] (or sugar)
*½ tbsp dark [[Cookbook:Sesame Oil|sesame oil]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] cayenne salt, if necessary
*1 tbsp toasted [[Cookbook:Sesame Seed|sesame seeds]]

==Preparation==
#Rinse the seaweed and soak until it has increased 10 times in size, about 5 minutes. Gently squeeze to remove excess water. 
#Remove any hard bits of seaweed and chop the rest. Put pieces in a bowl.
#[[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|Toss]] with the shallot, soy sauce, vinegar, mirin (or sugar), sesame oil, cayenne, and salt (if necessary). Taste and add seasonings as needed.
#Garnish with sesame seeds.
